title: Hong Kong: Hung Hom deepfake romance scam centre
summary: In October 2024 Hong Kong police arrested 27 people for allegedly using online romance scams to trick victims into fake investments totalling about HK$360 million. The syndicate, run by members with triad backgrounds, operated from a 4,000-square-foot industrial unit in Hung Hom, used AI-generated images and deepfakes to pose as women online, and trained its scammers. Victims were mostly men from India, Singapore and Malaysia. The group recruited some members under false pretences of clerical jobs. These are arrests; the investigation was ongoing.
